summary: The review is internally consistent and closely tracks the underlying evidence. All headline numbers (7/7 tests passed, 10063ms install duration, 0 manual interventions, 1 automated adjustment, 3 partial claims, reproduced=True across 7 tests, slowest test 1781ms, peak RAM 38660997 bytes) match the evaluation.json/final.json/replay.json data exactly. Dimension scores and their stated reasons are traceable to specific evidence (e.g., documentation score references the T06 exit-code correction, which is itself well-documented and transparently explained rather than hidden). Claim statuses (PASS/PARTIAL) and their explanations are appropriately hedged — e.g., CLAIM-001 flagged PARTIAL because the registry install command wasn't run verbatim, CLAIM-007 flagged PARTIAL because only installed metadata was checked, not actual enforcement under Python <3.10. No exaggerated language, unsupported superlatives, or fabricated numbers were found. The verdict (WORTH IT, overall 84, HIGH confidence) is proportionate to the evidence shown.
